models_evaluated: GE Healthcare Omni Legend AI-based automatic patient positioning (3D camera neural network)

links.outcome: Off-centering >2.5 cm before vs after correcting camera mounting-angle installation error
links.effect: Before recalibration, AI positioning was no better than manual (49% vs 54% of studies off-centered >2.5 cm). After recalibration, 27% (38/140), p<0.001.
links.quote: With respect to off-centering measurements, although there was not any significant difference between the AI and manual methods before the positioning camera recalibration, afterwards the number of studies with greater than 2.5 cm off-centering dropped from about one-half to one-quarter, confirming its efficacy for PET/CT.

models_evaluated: GE Healthcare Omni Legend AI-based automatic patient positioning system

links.outcome: Patient off-centering associated with an incorrectly mounted AI positioning camera
links.effect: A camera mounting-angle error was discovered during deployment. Off-centering improved from 2.69 ± 1.45 cm before recalibration to 1.96 ± 1.15 cm afterward (p < 0.001).
links.quote: As indicated by Fig. 5 A, after recalibration of the dBGO auto-positioning camera, the dBGO total off-centering improved significantly to from 2.69 ± 1.45 cm before recalibration to 1.96 ± 1.15 cm after recalibration ( p < 0.001) and was also superior to the dLYSO measurements of 2.72 ± 1.28 cm and 2.75 ± 1.19 cm for before and after recalibration ( p < 0.001, Mann–Whitney).

links.outcome: Excessive patient off-centering before and after correction of the camera calibration
links.effect: Off-centering > 2.5 cm decreased from 49% (143/292, p < 0.001) before recalibration to 27% (38/140) afterward; the manual-positioning comparator remained virtually unchanged across the recalibration date.
links.quote: Also, after recalibration, 27% (38/140) of the studies had off-centerings > 2.5 cm for dBGO, which was significantly better than the 49% (143/292, p < 0.001) before recalibration or the 54% (185/343, p < 0.001) for dLYSO (Fig. 5 B).
